questions.question: What are the three basic steps to follow during an earthquake?
questions.correct_answer: Drop, Cover, Hold On

questions.question: What is the main cause of most earthquakes?
options: Movement along faults in the Earth's crust
questions.correct_answer: Movement along faults in the Earth's crust

questions.question: What should you do during an earthquake if you are indoors?
options: Take cover under a sturdy table or desk
questions.correct_answer: Take cover under a sturdy table or desk

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a reliable warning sign of a major earthquake?
questions.correct_answer: Unusual animal behavior

questions.question: What should you do after an earthquake?
options: Check for injuries and watch for hazards
questions.correct_answer: Check for injuries and watch for hazards

questions.question: What should you do when floodwater starts rising?
questions.correct_answer: Move to higher ground

questions.question: Why should you avoid walking through moving floodwater?
options: It can contain hidden hazards and strong currents
questions.correct_answer: It can contain hidden hazards and strong currents

questions.question: Which of the following can cause flooding?
questions.correct_answer: All of the above

questions.question: What should you do if authorities issue an evacuation order during a flood?
options: Ignore it until water enters your home
Wait for social media updates only
questions.correct_answer: Follow the evacuation instructions

questions.question: Why should you avoid touching electrical equipment while standing in floodwater?
options: It may cause equipment damage only
It may create an electrical shock hazard
questions.correct_answer: It may create an electrical shock hazard

questions.question: What three things are required for the basic fire triangle?
questions.correct_answer: Heat, fuel and oxygen

questions.question: What should you do first when you discover a fire?
options: Raise the alarm and inform people nearby
questions.correct_answer: Raise the alarm and inform people nearby

questions.question: What should you do if smoke is present during a fire?
questions.correct_answer: Stay low to the ground

questions.question: Which fire should NOT normally be fought with water?
questions.correct_answer: An energized electrical fire

questions.question: When should you NOT attempt to use a fire extinguisher?
options: When the fire is small and contained
When you are trained and have a safe exit
When the fire is large, spreading or producing heavy smoke
When the correct extinguisher is available
questions.correct_answer: When the fire is large, spreading or producing heavy smoke

questions.question: What should you do before helping an injured person?
options: Check whether the scene is safe
questions.correct_answer: Check whether the scene is safe

questions.question: What should you do for a suspected fracture?
options: Keep the area as still as reasonably possible
questions.correct_answer: Keep the area as still as reasonably possible

questions.question: What should you NOT do during a seizure?
options: Protect the person's head if possible
Put something in the person's mouth
questions.correct_answer: Put something in the person's mouth

questions.question: What is recommended for cooling a minor thermal burn?
questions.correct_answer: Use cool running water

questions.question: What should you do if a person may still be connected to an electrical source?
options: Pull them away with bare hands
Do not touch them until the electrical hazard is safely isolated
questions.correct_answer: Do not touch them until the electrical hazard is safely isolated
